name: Carousel
docs: Slides shown one at a time with previous and next buttons and dots. The slides are the children. The page keeps the index in `value` and learns of a change from `change`; autoplay is off unless the programmer turns it on, and a reduced-motion preference turns it off.

props.name: previous
props.docs: accessible name of the previous button

props.name: next
props.docs: accessible name of the next button

events.name: change
events.docs: a button or a dot moved to another slide

svelte.reason: motion needs timers, animation frames or media APIs and a reduced-motion rule; it is written by the programmer behind this contract

react.reason: motion needs timers, animation frames or media APIs and a reduced-motion rule; it is written by the programmer behind this contract
